{{Vanilla|Ice}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Ice''' is a slippery, translucent block. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds recipes that turn snow into ice and every kind of ice back into its parts. See [[Snow]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
* Nine snow blocks make 1 ice, and 1 ice crafts back into 9 snow blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ice_from_snow_block.json}}</ref>
* Packed ice crafts into 9 ice.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ice_from_packed_ice.json}}</ref>
